name: agent-harness
description: Neurofebric kernel and Pi extension. No RUNTIME dependencies: the harness runs on bare node. The single devDependency below is static type-checking tooling and is never imported by platform/ code (see docs/DECISIONS.md D-018).

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:mjs && npm run test:ts && node --experimental-strip-types --test platform/**/*.test.ts scripts/**/*.test.ts
scripts.test:ts: node --experimental-strip-types --test platform/core/*.test.ts platform/pi/*.test.ts platform/conductor/*.test.ts platform/ingestion/*.test.ts platform/web/*.test.ts platform/omniroute/*.test.ts platform/omniroute/providers/*.test.ts platform/egress/*.test.ts platform/swarm/*.test.ts platform/swarm/agents/*.test.ts platform/api/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts platform/memory/*.test.ts platform/embassy/*.test.ts
